```cpp
void foo(unsigned int *b) {

}
```

comments.author: davemgreen
comments.body: This should probably be expanded pre-isel again, similar to #167760. Probably in shouldExpandAtomicCmpXchgInIR this time.

issue.title: [AArch64] crash on __scoped_atomic_uinc_wrap
